studio.label: About
studio.title: The Studio

founder.name: Brankica
founder.paragraph1: She runs every Stellar project herself, from the first conversation to the final detail on site, and is part of every decision along the way. So there's always someone who knows your project as well as you do.
founder.paragraph2: Above all, she keeps the whole team focused on the people we design for: how you live and work, what you need and what you hope for. For us, a project is only finished when it truly feels like yours.
founder.photoAlt: Brankica, architect and founder of Stellar

studio.tagline: Great architecture is born from listening — to the site, to the light, and above all, to the people.
studio.paragraph1: Stellar was founded with a simple conviction: every project, regardless of scale, deserves the same depth of thought and care. From private residences to public institutions, we approach each commission as an opportunity to create spaces that elevate everyday life.
studio.paragraph2: Our studio combines rigorous technical expertise with a deep sensitivity to context, materiality, and human experience. We work collaboratively with clients, engineers, and craftspeople to realize designs that are both ambitious and enduring.

gia-house.title: GIA House
gia-house.description: A modern residential house in Berovo, North Macedonia, designed with a focus on natural light and open spaces. The building features a clean, minimalist aesthetic with large windows and a seamless integration of indoor and outdoor living.

brash-fashion.title: Brash Fashion
brash-fashion.description: A contemporary fashion boutique designed around clarity, symmetry, and refined minimalism. The space features a clean grid layout with central display islands and perimeter shelving, creating intuitive circulation and strong visual balance. Neutral tones, soft integrated lighting, and natural wood accents highlight the merchandise while maintaining a calm, gallery-like atmosphere. The result is a modern retail environment that enhances product visibility and elevates the shopping experience.

alb-petrol.title: ALB Petrol
alb-petrol.description: Modern petrol station facade defined by clean geometry, a bold cantilevered canopy, and integrated LED lighting for strong day-night visibility. A restrained palette and transparent storefront create a clear, durable, and recognizable architectural identity.

sv-weekend-house.title: SV Weekend House
sv-weekend-house.description: A weekend house located in the serene countryside of Suvi Laki, North Macedonia. The design emphasizes a strong connection to nature, with large windows framing picturesque views and a spacious deck that extends into the landscape. The interior features a warm, minimalist aesthetic with natural materials and an open floor plan that encourages relaxation and socializing.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.audience: For families planning their own home, and for investors developing a residential or commercial building.
architecture.desc: You have one point of contact from the first sketch to the building permit. We take on the coordination, so you can follow the progress without having to manage it.
points: Engineers and specialists for every phase
Communication with the municipality and institutions, through to the building permit
architecture.summary: One point of contact from the first sketch to the building permit, with the documentation, engineers and institutions coordinated for you.

interiors.title: Interiors
interiors.audience: For owners furnishing a whole home, especially an apartment under construction or before a renovation, and for shops, offices and hospitality spaces.
interiors.desc: We plan the space around how it will be used: the layout, light, materials, furniture and the details that get built. Then you decide how much you hand over.

options.title: Design project
options.desc: Complete drawings, specifications and visualizations, for when you'll organize the works yourself.

options.title: Turnkey
options.desc: We also run the realization — contractors, suppliers, orders and installation — through to the finished space.

interiors.summary: A complete interior design, or a turnkey space with the contractors, suppliers and installation coordinated for you.

glowUp.title: Interior glow-up
glowUp.audience: For a home that needs a refresh or one you've just moved into, a place you're preparing to sell or rent out, and shops, offices or cafés that want a fresh look.
glowUp.desc: An expert designer's eye, without a renovation. We work with the space you already have and bring it to life with colour, light, textiles, decor and art, so it feels new again.

options.title: Styling plan
options.desc: A visit to your space, then a clear plan: colour palette, lighting and a shopping list for textiles, decor and art, ready for you to put in place.

options.title: Turnkey
options.desc: We take care of everything — sourcing and orders, painters and installers, and a final styling day — so you come back to a finished space.

glowUp.summary: An expert designer refreshes your space with colour, light, textiles and art — as a plan to follow, or fully turnkey.

beforeYouBuy.title: Before you buy an apartment
beforeYouBuy.audience: For buyers already considering a specific apartment.
beforeYouBuy.desc: Together we assess the layout, daylight, storage and what can still be changed, measured against how you actually live. You leave with a short written summary that makes the decision clearer.
beforeYouBuy.summary: Three hours on a specific apartment — layout, daylight, storage — and a written summary to help you decide.

dayWithArchitect.title: A day with an architect
dayWithArchitect.audience: For clients with a specific interior or house question who plan to carry on themselves.
dayWithArchitect.desc: We agree on your questions in advance and dedicate a full day to them: preparation, a working session together, and a clear set of sketches and guidelines for your next steps.
dayWithArchitect.summary: A full day dedicated to your questions, with sketches and guidelines so you can carry on yourself.
